changelog.body:
- **Fixed: Nekogram showed "Your Telegram client may be an incompatible version"** in the log
  with Prevent media on, after 1.2. Nothing was broken, and the warning is gone.


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **Re: TeleVIP** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

No root? Patch your Telegram client with **LSPatch 1.2** (JingMatrix) and add Re: TeleVIP to it.

- **Ghost Mode works again with Block ads on.** With both switched on, Ghost Mode quietly did
  nothing: chats were marked as read and others could see you typing and online. Now your
  "seen", typing and online status stay hidden.
- **Self-destructing photos stay.** On Telegram 13.1, a timed photo still expired after you
  opened it. It now stays, as "Prevent media" promises.
- **Works without root through LSPatch 1.2.** Patch your Telegram client with JingMatrix's
  LSPatch, in Local or Integrated mode, and add Re: TeleVIP to it. The README has the steps.
- **Plus Messenger is supported**, and checked every week like the other clients.
- **Telegram 13.1 and 13.0.3 (Play Store) are supported.** The error about the secret media
  viewer is gone.
- **Save edits history works in Nagram 1253 and Momogram 13**, where it found nothing to hook.
- **Forkgram Classic 13 shows the Re: TeleVIP entry in its side menu again.**
- **No more crash from the edits-history storage** ("Can't downgrade database from version 2
  to 1") after switching from another TeleVip build. Your saved edits are kept.
- **Hide phone number shows "Number hidden"** instead of "+null" in Settings.
- **Hide app update also hides the update pop-up** that Nekogram shows when you open the app.
- **Long setting titles wrap neatly** and no longer cover the line under them, in every
  language.
- **Checked on Android 13 to 16** with Magisk, KernelSU, KernelSU Next, BakaSU and APatch,
  and Vector, in all 12 supported clients. The README shows which ones were tried on each
  Android version.


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **Re: TeleVIP** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

No root? Patch your Telegram client with **LSPatch 1.2** (JingMatrix) and add Re: TeleVIP to it.

- **Redesigned settings.** Each group (Ghost Mode, Stories, Messages, Connections, Media, UI and
  Other Features) is now its own card with an icon, and every option has a short line under it
  saying what it does, in English, Arabic, Persian and Chinese. "Restart required" sits on its own
  line. Your saved settings are kept.
- **Join the Re: TeleVIP group.** The developer channel button is replaced by the new group,
  [t.me/Re_TeleVIP](https://t.me/Re_TeleVIP), shown with the app's logo. The join prompt points
  there too.


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **LSPosed 1.10+** or **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **TeleVip** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

- **Fixed: Block Ads' second barrier did nothing on Nagram and Nekogram.** When an ad request
  got through anyway, the module could not build the "no ads" answer to put in place of the
  server's, because those builds strip its constructor (they never create it themselves). It is
  now made without one, with its lists empty as usual.
- **The hook health line no longer reports code a client removed on purpose as missing.** Nagram
  X drops search ads (`contacts.getSponsoredPeers`), some Nagram builds drop
  `MessagesController.getSponsoredMessages` and Nekogram drops the settings row's icon cell; the
  module already covered each another way, but logged them as "missing" and "Your Telegram client
  may be an incompatible version". They are now listed as "not in this build (fallback in use)",
  with the reason, and a class that is not found is logged and counted once.
- The list of what a build may lack now lives in the module itself, so the weekly client check
  and the module's own report always agree. Checked on Telegram 13.0.3, Nekogram 13.0.2,
  Cherrygram 11.3.0, Nagram 1253, Nagram X 1260 and Momogram 12.10.6: every hook resolves.


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **LSPosed 1.10+** or **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **TeleVip** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

- **Fixed: Re: TeleVIP on Nekogram 13.0.2**, the first build on Telegram 13.0: secret media
  saving, keeping messages forwardable, the voice-to-music switch and reading secret messages
  could not find their code. Telegram 13 adds a table of every message type that misled the
  module's lookup; it now skips it.
- **Fixed: Re: TeleVIP on Nagram 1253** (12.10.6): its colours (dark theme check, message time
  paint) were not found because Nagram now renames the theme class.


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **LSPosed 1.10+** or **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **TeleVip** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

- Build: Bump gradle-wrapper from 9.8.0 to 9.8.1 in the gradle group (#5)


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **LSPosed 1.10+** or **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **TeleVip** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

- **Fixed: Re: TeleVIP Settings could open empty**, showing only its title bar (reported on
  Nagram X 12.9.2). The list was built on the client's own RecyclerView, which forks rename,
  strip or change. It is now a plain scrolling list of the same rows, built directly, so it
  depends on nothing the client may have changed; a row the client cannot build is left out
  instead of blanking the whole screen. This also removes the separate settings adapter that
  was injected into the client.
- **Momogram 12.10.x: every feature works.** Momogram renames and reorders much of its code,
  and looks its strings up by resource id, so Save secret media, Show deleted messages, edits
  history and more found nothing to hook. Hide app update is no longer offered there: Momogram
  updates itself through its own updater.
- **Nagram X's "base" build** (`nu.gpu.nagramx`) is supported.
- The weekly client check now also covers Momogram and Nagram X base: ten clients, the last
  five releases of each.


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **LSPosed 1.10+** or **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **TeleVip** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

- **The module is now named "Re: TeleVIP"** in LSPosed / Vector and in Android's app list (it
  was "TeleVip"), and as the title of the account-age dialog in profile menus. The README, here
  and in the Xposed Modules Repo, uses the new name too. The package name and the APK's file
  name are unchanged.


### Install

1. Download **TeleVip-…-release.apk** below and install it (uninstall a debug build first).
2. In **LSPosed 1.10+** or **Vector 2.2+**: **Modules** → enable **TeleVip** → tick your Telegram clients.
3. **Force stop** the client and reopen it.

# Re: TeleVIP **Privacy, ad blocking and quality-of-life features for Telegram and its forks,
as a Vector / Xposed module.** [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP?label=release&color=FFD500)](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/releases/latest) [![Downloads](https://img.shields.io/github/downloads/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/total?color=2AABEE)](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/releases) [![Client watch](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/client-watch.yml?label=client%20watch)](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/actions/workflows/client-watch.yml) [![Xposed API](https://img.shields.io/badge/libxposed-API%20102-4A4D54)](#-getting-started) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-F99B1C)](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/blob/main/LICENSE)
[![Download the latest APK](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-latest%20APK-2AABEE?style=for-the-badge&logo=android&logoColor=white)](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/releases/latest) [Changelog](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · [Telegram group](https://t.me/Re_TeleVIP) · [Report a problem](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/issues)

## ✨ Features
🛡️ Privacy 🎞️ Media & stories 💬 Chats
Ghost Mode: no seen, typing or online Save protected stories Remove content-saving restrictions
Hide phone number Save voice messages Save message edit history
Hide story views Save secret media Hide pinned messages
Show deleted messages Always allow saving media Disable stories
Keep secret media from self-destructing Faster downloads Disable channel / profile swipe-back
Show user IDs on profiles Local Premium Jump to first / any message
Block ads: sponsored posts, video and search ads, proxy sponsor Hijri and Persian dates Hide app update prompts
…and more in Re: TeleVIP Settings 🛸, at the top of the client's own Settings.
## 🚀 Getting started
Requirements Install
- **Vector 2.2+**
Re: TeleVIP uses the new Xposed API (102). LSPosed 1.9.x and EdXposed only run older modules, and LSPosed doesn't start on Android 16. - A root manager with Zygisk
Magisk has it built in. With KernelSU, KernelSU Next, BakaSU or APatch, add NeoZygisk or Zygisk Next. - No root? **[LSPatch 1.2](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch/releases/latest)** by JingMatrix
Android 9 or newer. See Without root below. - Android 8.1 or newer - On Android 17: Magisk 31.0+ and a Vector canary (3112 or newer)
Magisk 30.7 and Vector 2.2 stable don't load modules on Android 17. 		1. Download `TeleVip-…-release.apk` from the [latest release](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/releases/latest) and install it. 2. In Vector: **Modules** → enable **Re: TeleVIP** → tick your Telegram clients. 3. **Force stop** the client and open it again. Updating from 1.0.x? The package name changed in 1.1.0: install the new version, uninstall the old TeleVip (com.my.televip), and enable Re: TeleVIP in Vector.
Without root (LSPatch)
1. Install **Re: TeleVIP** and the **LSPatch** manager. 2. In LSPatch, tap **+**, pick your Telegram client and choose a patch mode: - **Local**: LSPatch serves the module. Updating Re: TeleVIP only needs a restart of the client. - **Integrated**: tick **Embed modules** → **Re: TeleVIP**. The patched app runs on its own, but every Re: TeleVIP update means patching again. 3. Patch, then install the result. In Local mode, also tick Re: TeleVIP on the client's page in LSPatch. The patched client is signed by LSPatch, so Android has to uninstall the original one first. That deletes what the client keeps on the phone, Re: TeleVIP's settings and secret chats included: you'll sign in again and your cloud chats come back. Updates from the Play Store or the client's own updater won't install over it; patch each new version instead.

## 📱 Supported clients ### ✅ Checked every week Every Monday, each feature's hook points are checked against the latest releases of these clients.
A release that breaks something opens an issue.

Telegram
telegram.org
Nekogram
GitHub
Cherrygram
GitHub
Nagram
GitHub
Nagram X
GitHub · full + base

Forkgram
F-Droid
Forkgram Classic
F-Droid
Mercurygram
F-Droid
Momogram
GitHub
Plus Messenger
APKPure
Telegram: its newest build. The others: their last five releases. App icons belong to their respective projects and are shown only to identify them.
## 🧪 Tested on Every release is tried on Android emulators with each root manager and Vector, in every client above.
These are the combinations that were checked for 1.2:
Android Works with Notes
16         Magisk, KernelSU, KernelSU Next, BakaSU and APatch
15   Magisk and APatch. KernelSU wasn't checked: it can't run on this emulator's kernel*
14   Magisk and APatch. KernelSU wasn't checked: it can't run on this emulator's kernel*
13 Magisk
17 — Not tested for 1.2. Earlier builds needed Magisk 31.0+ and a Vector canary there.
* The Android 14 and 15 emulators ship kernels that KernelSU, KernelSU Next and BakaSU can't load into. That is a limit of the emulator, not of these root managers or of Re: TeleVIP: on a phone whose kernel they support, they work as on Android 16.
Logos belong to their respective projects and are shown only to identify them.
## ⚙️ How it keeps up Telegram and its forks rename their code on every release, some almost all of it.
Re: TeleVIP doesn't rely on a name table for one version. It works it out on your device.
📦
Reads the client's APK
once per client update		 🔍
Finds each hook by behaviour
what the code does, not its name		 🧭
Leaves out what it can't pin down
rather than guessing
Details are in the [changelog](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
## 🙏 Credits **[Mustafa (@mustafa1dev)](https://github.com/mustafa1dev)** is the original author of TeleVip ([mustafa1dev/TeleVip-LSPosed](https://github.com/mustafa1dev/TeleVip-LSPosed)), which Re: TeleVIP continues.
Partly based on [Re-Telegram](https://github.com/Sakion-Team/Re-Telegram). ## 📄 License [GPL-3.0](https://github.com/2B-4G10/Re-TeleVIP/blob/main/LICENSE). This project is for educational use.
Modified clients can put a Telegram account at risk, so use it at your own risk.
